login.title: Sign in
login.msg_sso_waiting:
Complete the MyAccess sign-in in your browser.
You will continue automatically when done.
login.msg_invalid_endpoint:
The server URL is not valid.
e.g. https://aimeeting.mobile.skhynix.com/m
login.msg_network_error:
Cannot connect to the server.
Check your company network connection.
login.msg_invalid_response:
The sign-in response is not valid.
Please try again.
terms.title: Terms Notice
terms.body: Please go to the AI Minutes system ({url}) on your PC and agree to the terms before using the app.
mic_test.title: Microphone Test
mic_test.capture_mode_help: Choose Meeting audio only to leave out your own voice and record only the other participants from Zoom, Webex, Teams, etc. Use it when several participants' recordings will be merged later.
mic_test.system_only_hint: Your voice will not be recorded. The meeting app's audio must be playing on this PC; the microphone is used only for time sync.
mic_test.system_sound_help: System sound records the other participants' voices played on this PC during online meetings such as Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom.
mic_test.notice_1: Get recording consent from all participants before the meeting.
mic_test.notice_2: Recognition may be less accurate if voices are distant or it is noisy.
mic_test.notice_3: The maximum recording time is 3 hours.
mic_test.notice_4: Recording may fail if storage space is low.
recording.noti_default: Being recorded. Be sure to get everyone's consent.
recording.noti_early_desc: Check mute status or the mic connection.
recording.noti_sustained_desc: Check mic/PC audio connections and sound settings.
recording.popup_device_added: A device was added. Returning to the start screen.
recording.popup_device_removed: A device was removed. Returning to the start screen.
recording.popup_disk_low_subtitle: There is not enough space on this PC to save the recording.
recording.popup_disk_low_warning: Free up at least 500MB of space.
recording.popup_disk_critical_warning: Recording will stop automatically in about 3 minutes.
recording.popup_disk_stop_subtitle: Recording stopped because the PC is low on storage.
recording.popup_disk_stop_warning: The recording so far has been saved safely. To record more, free up disk space.
recording.popup_device_lost_subtitle: The audio device used for recording was disconnected, so recording stopped automatically.
recording.popup_device_lost_warning: Reconnect the device and press the record button.
recording.popup_max_duration_title:
The maximum recording time was reached
and recording stopped automatically.
recording.popup_max_duration_subtitle:
Upload what has been recorded so far?
(If you cancel, the recording will be deleted.)
recording.popup_app_close_recording_titl:
Recording in progress.
Stop recording and upload the file?
recording.popup_app_close_recording_subt: If you don't upload, the recording will be deleted.
recording.popup_busy_change_device: You can't change devices while recording.
recording.popup_busy_logout: You can't sign out while recording.
recording.popup_busy_language: You can't change the language while recording.
recording.popup_busy_subtitle: Finish the recording (upload or cancel), then try again.
recording.popup_logout_subtitle:
You will need to sign in again to use the app.
Files in the upload list will be kept.
popup.uploading_subtitle: Please wait until the upload is complete.
popup.upload_eta: Please wait until the upload is complete. (about {eta} left)
popup.upload_finishing_subtitle: The server is checking the file...
popup.upload_failed_default_reason: A network or server error occurred.
popup.upload_done_go_home: The device changed, so the app will return to the start screen.
popup.upload_done_continue: To keep recording, click the record button.
popup.logout_blocked_title: You can't sign out right now.
popup.logout_blocked_subtitle: A file is being uploaded. Try again after the upload finishes.
popup.recovery_subtitle: {count} recording(s) from an abnormal shutdown were found.
popup.recovery_warning: Check them in the upload list and upload them.
upload_list.title: Upload List
upload_list.retry_subtitle: The selected item will be uploaded.
summarize.title: Prepare AI Summary
summarize.select_required: Select a language and the number of speakers.
update.title: Update
update.downloading_desc:
Downloading the new version.
Please wait.
update.installing_desc:
The app will close briefly and restart automatically.
If an administrator permission prompt appears, click 'Yes'.
update.failed_desc:
You can keep using the current version for now.
The update will be retried the next time you start the app.
